description:
The Lodge, Ballina is a boutique Airbnb hidden gem in the heart of Ballina town.  The Lodge provides a luxurious stay on the Wild Atlantic Way with 20 No . bed spaces over 5 Rooms.
  Set in a beautiful cobblestone courtyard with Dillions Restaurant and Billy's restaurant on your doorstep.  

Enter through the Arch marked "Dillons Bar Restaurant" off Dillon terrace just before you cross over the River Moy on Lower Bridge (F26N971). 

Accommodation; the property is currently laid out as 5 rooms over three floors. 
 Ground floor Room 1 consists of two double beds and one single bed (5 bed spaces) overlooking the cobble courtyard through the large arched windows.  Fully furnished with large bathroom/ ensuite.  Also on the ground floor is the reception area and laundry room. 

 First floor; Room 2  consists of one double bed and two single beds(4 bed spaces) as well as a large bathroom/ ensuite. 
 Room 3  consists of two double beds and one single (5 bed spaces) with bathroom/ensuite.

Second floor; Room 4 consists of one double bed (2 bed spaces) with ensuite. 
 Room 5 is a Suite which consists of two bedrooms both with double beds (4 bed spaces) and shared bathroom/ensuite.  
There is storage in the attic space which can be accessed through a loft ladder. 

Shared car parking spaces to the rear of the Bond Store Building.  The building forms part of the Bond Store Management Company Limited by Guarantee.  

The Lodge is available as a going concern, with the website and future bookings included or someone may wish to convert the ground floor to living dining area and let if on a rent a room basis long term.  This is a really good property in a great location for long or short term leasing or letting.  Guilt edged investment opportunity.  Viewings available through the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where we don't just list property we Sell It.
